name: guance-rum-windows-electron-sample
description: Electron hybrid UI acceptance sample for Guance Windows RUM

scripts.dev: npm run electron:install && npm run build && concurrently --kill-others --success command-electron --names renderer,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.start: npm run electron:install && npm run build && electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run electron:install && npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 electron .
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
